data.one_liner: Generates routing and dependency‑injection boilerplate for Stacked apps.
data.what_it_does: The package reads a StackedApp annotation and creates the necessary route definitions and service registration code. It reduces manual setup of navigation and DI in Stacked projects. The generated code works with the Stacked framework version 1.9.0+.
use_when: You want to scaffold Stacked applications quickly without writing repetitive routing/DI code
You are already using the Stacked architecture and need compile‑time generation of routes and services
avoid_when: You are not using Stacked or prefer manual setup
You need runtime‑only DI without code generation
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate for Stacked routing and DI
Integrates directly with Stacked’s annotation system
Keeps generated code type‑safe and up‑to‑date
weaknesses: Tied to the Stacked framework, not useful for other architectures
Requires build_runner to run the generator
data.setup_notes: Add stacked_generator to dev_dependencies, run `flutter pub run build_runner build` after adding a StackedApp annotation.

alternatives.name: source_gen
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a generic code‑generation framework; you could write custom generators instead of using stacked_generator
